title: stachys germanica var. cassia
intro: Stachys germanica var. cassia, commonly known as Wood Betony, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Wood Betony include its ability to reduce inflammation and relieve spasms, making it a potential remedy for digestive issues and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of Wood Betony include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
